data.title: TSC2-Mutant Yucatan Minipig Cardiac Rhabdomyoma Model Reveals mTORC1 Activation and MITF/TFE Expression Signature
data.authors: Bou Farhat E; Du H; Carreon CK; Halawi J; Kudler S; Losko M; Herbert ZT; Watson AL; Carlson D; Webster DA; Korpela DM; Meredith DM; Henske EP; Kwiatkowski DJ

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: A heterozygous TSC2 p.Arg505\* minipig developed cardiac rhabdomyomas resembling the human lesions, with mTORC1 signalling activation and an MITF/TFE-regulated lysosomal gene signature shared with human tumours. Animal model only; other TSC manifestations were not seen up to one year of age.
data.abstract_excerpt: Tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) is an inherited tumor predisposition syndrome caused by pathogenic variants in TSC1 or TSC2, yet no animal model faithfully recapitulates the cardiac rhabdomyomas (CR) that are among its earliest manifestations. We generated a heterozygous TSC2-mutant Yucatan minipig carrying the recurrent pathogenic TSC2 p.Arg505* variant and characterized its cardiac phenotype using histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and RNA sequencing.

extracted_findings.effect: TSC2-mutant minipigs develop cardiac rhabdomyomas with mTORC1 activation and an MITF/TFE lysosomal signature
